This is the declaration face. The review is owed by the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line alone. `check-governed-merges --pr 36978` finds 0 governed paths. No `packages/spec/src/**` and no `skills/**` are in the 23 paths, and there is no narrowing. Claim 7136577815.

Inputs read:
- Card #36897, claim 7129933904 and amendment 7135813774. `readClause2Line` on the amendment gives `declared · yes · widening`.
- Dev report 7135761410. Its "Clause-② is no" line predates the amendment, which supersedes it.
- The PR body (lines 6–9).
- The net diff `origin/main...f1f10706`. `git diff 00e524f1 f1f10706` is the changeset's declaration line alone.
- Check-runs on `f1f10706`: 41 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed, 1 pending (a PR-body guard re-run after the body patch).

Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **J1, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` public surface.** The package is published (no `private`). `ObjectGridComponentProps` is exported from its entry (`src/index.ts:59`, also as the deprecated alias `ObjectGridProps`), and it gains two optional members:
  - `hostCells?: Readonly<Record<string, (value, record) => ReactNode>>`;
  - `rowTint?: (record) => string | null | undefined`.

  This is additive. With both absent, `tableColumns` is `orderedColumns` exactly as before, and `rowClassName` is set only when `schema.rowColor` is, as before. No existing member changes.
- **J2, nothing an author writes reaches either prop.** Both are runtime React props documented as "never authored metadata". No schema key, SDUI manifest input or node key is added. `rowTintClass` admits only palette names, never a raw `bg-*` class, so a host cannot inject a class through it. That is stricter than an authored `rowColor`.
- **J3, `useRowColor.ts`.** `rowTintClass` is a new export of the module. It is used by `ObjectGrid` and the test. It is not re-exported from the package entry, so it adds nothing to J1.
- **J4, `@object-ui/app-shell`** is `private: true`, so the list's adapter (`metadataListGrid.ts`), the create dialog and the area's `pairCreate` host member are not a published surface.
- **J5, the wire.** No server, door or spec file moves. The list still reads `/meta/:type`, the existing ensure door (`ensureCustomizationPackage`), `save` in draft mode with `ifNoneMatch: '*'`, and `publishSavedItem`. These are the same calls the pillars make, through the same helpers.
- **J6, `Metadata-protocol: none`.** Nothing an author writes moves.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` reads the same on all three carriers: the changeset body, PR body line 6, and claim amendment 7135813774. That matches J1 and this seat's precedent (#36983, #36973; `.changeset/36011-restore-factory-view.md`).
- `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/app-shell` is right for a non-protocol widening with `Metadata-protocol: none`. Not breaking, so no ADR-0087 disposition is owed.
- **F1 (nit).** The changeset's plugin-grid bullet names the two props but not the exported type that carries them (`ObjectGridComponentProps`). The PR body's widening sentence does. This is prose only.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`:** none.
- **Deviations:** an images-only screenshot branch, the body brought to head by the area, HotCRM verified on its pinned 18.6.0 server with this tree's console, one push while overlap-check flagged PRs that have since merged, and gate families mostly run at `2c60bdf3`. None has a contract effect. CI is green on this head, apart from the body-guard re-run.
- **`out_of_scope_findings`:** two. Two right-pinned columns overlap, and this list pins one. A customization-read skew appears on HotCRM 18.6.0 against main's reader, which is version skew. Both are noted rather than filed, which is the seat's call.
- **SQL push-down:** no finding. The rows are the `/meta/:type` answer the page already read, held in memory and paged 50 at a time. The largest type under `~all` measured 136 rows (`object`), as item 7 asks.
- **Author:** `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no author note is owed.

F1 has no effect on correctness or the contract, so this is the final round.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#3 · head f1f10706 · 2026-11-24T15:48Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: `f1f10706347dc5507c76ab2d134bf0b6a137ae19`
Reviewer: L1-b (3) (seat 3, area ux-E2).
Contract review: `TIER_DEFAULT` PASS 7136626887 on this head (claim 7136577815). It is final, with nit F1 only.
Tier: not Tier H. This is card #36897's only PR: 23 files, +1771/−424 (2,195 lines, under the 3,000-line per-card line). `check-governed-merges --pr 36978`: not governed.

### Read
- I read the net diff `origin/main...f1f10706`, the PR body, card #36897 with claim 7129933904, amendment 7135813774 and dev report 7135761410.
- Check-runs on `f1f10706`: 42 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. Mergeable is `clean`. `l1-face.mjs --pr 36978`: clean (the earlier pending was the body-guard re-run, now green).
- Screenshot `all-sharing-rule-list.png` (`3c488ba2`): an ObjectGrid table with a sort arrow on Name, the lock banner, and the Active switch plus Clone together in the pinned controls column.

### Checklist
- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36897`, plus `Part of #36890`. Items 1–5 and 7 are delivered here, and item 6 is left by design (decision 13). So `Fixes` is right.
- **Scope.** The claim's surface, plus the amendment's four files (`metadataAreaHost.ts`, `useRowColor.ts`, the live sharing-rule spec, the create-dialog enumeration test). Each is named in the body. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and the pillar files are untouched. `builtinComponents.tsx`, `anchors.ts` and `servedListColumns.tsx` are read only.
- **Item 1, the adapter.** `metadataListGrid.ts` has `MetadataListSource`, which extends `ValueDataSource` and answers a declared schema: one text field per column under a positional field `c<i>`, never guessed from a row. Rows carry only `id` plus column values. The item, package, lock and diagnostics are looked up by key (`rowInfoOf`). Met.
- **Item 2, the generic grid props.** `hostCells` and `rowTint` are generic, with no product-named component. When both are absent the grid behaves as before. `rowTintClass` admits palette names only. The Active switch still goes through `CatalogActiveCell` with its holder confirmation. Met.
- **Item 3, grid extras off.** `showSearch: false`, `selection: none`, `editable: false`, no resize or reorder, no export, no row actions (`metadataListGridSchema`). Met.
- **Item 4, columns and controlled state.**
  - The columns are the list's columns, from `servedListColumns` and the registrations, read not edited.
  - The rows reach the grid already filtered and sorted by `applyListState`, in host mode (`manualPagination`, `rowCount`, `onPageChange`).
  - A header sort writes `sort`, and paging writes `page`, which is cleared on every list-state write. The ‹ › order pin is unchanged.
  - #36898's 「修改时间」 column is re-hosted as a host cell with its `changed` header sort, and a new pin covers it.
  - Met.
- **Host-level list hooks kept.** A custom `ListPage` (datasource) still renders in place. `listFilter` (view) and `listInclude` (permission) still apply. The identity cell is still a `<Link>`, and the row click skips modified clicks, so new-tab and middle-click open as before.
- **Item 5, New on a read-only base.**
  - `MetadataListCreateDialog` creates an object (with the OWD picker, joining the app menu only outside a pair, as the Data pillar does) and a flow (presets, Advanced trigger list, born off). Both go through `ensureCustomizationPackage` and write to the answered package and namespace.
  - `AreaCreate` opens the pair's create for other types, only under `host.pairCreate`. That flag is set for a read-only, non-kernel base whose door is not walled.
  - Every helper is reused (`skeletons`, `packages-io`, `owd-sharing`, `flowPresets`, `newObjectJoinsAppMenu`, `publishSavedItem`, `findTakenIdentifier`).
  - HotCRM verification: an object and a flow landed in `app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom`, and on a self-built package they landed in that package. Met.
- **Item 6.** Dashboard and report New are not here (decision 13). Met.
- **Item 7.** Measured under `~all` on HotCRM: the largest type is `object` with 136 rows, paged 50 at a time (screenshot of page 3 of 3). Met.
- **Acceptance.** The ~36 suites naming the list page pass, and CI's Test UI 1–16 is green. 8 existing suites changed only where they pinned the old table's DOM or timing. I read them: the row test id moves to the identity cell and is reached by `closest('tr')`, and one awaits the grid's first draw. No assertion is weakened.
- **i18n.** No new keys. Every `t()`/`tFormat()` key the diff adds exists in the studio en and zh packs.
- **Changeset.** `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. I read it sentence by sentence and it matches the diff.

### Findings
No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **N1 (nit).** `MetadataListCreateDialog` repeats the pillars' create orchestration (target, taken check, draft save, publish, menu join) on top of the shared helpers. That is intended: the designer cards remove the pillars' own New entries. Until they do, a fix to one create path has to be made in both.
- **N2 (nit).** `AreaCreate` builds the pair's create address by composing onto a builder output (`${studioMetadataAreaPath(pair)}/${type}/new?…`). #36973's guard does not catch that shape (its L1 N2). Whichever of the two lands second can spell it `studioMetadataAreaAddress(pair, `${type}/new`, { query })`. This changes no bytes.
- **N3 (nit).** The screenshots predate the #36898 re-host, so none shows the 「修改时间」 column on the grid. This is declared, and it is covered by the re-hosted pins.
- **N4 (nit).** In the sharing-rule screenshot, the Package column truncates long ids (`app.objectstack.h…`). That is cosmetic.

ux-E2 can land it on full green. It conflicts by design with nothing open now: #36983 is merged in.
